roles.query_template: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(loan_amnt) AS decimal(38,2))) AS requested_total, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(funded_amnt) AS decimal(38,2))) AS funded_total, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(AVG(loan_amnt) AS decimal(20,6))) AS requested_avg, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(AVG(funded_amnt) AS decimal(20,6))) AS funded_avg FROM loans_fact

grounded_notes: ไม่มี currency metadata จึงไม่ระบุสกุลเงิน

roles.query_template: SELECT a.application_type, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CAST(100.0 * COUNT_BIG(*) / SUM(COUNT_BIG(*)) OVER () AS decimal(10,4)) AS portfolio_pct FROM loans_fact l JOIN application_type_dim a ON l.application_type_id = a.application_type_id GROUP BY a.application_type ORDER BY loan_count DESC

SELECT s.loan_status, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CAST(100.0 * COUNT_BIG(*) / SUM(COUNT_BIG(*)) OVER () AS decimal(10,4)) AS portfolio_pct FROM loans_fact l JOIN loan_status_dim s ON l.loan_status_id = s.loan_status_id GROUP BY s.loan_status ORDER BY loan_count DESC

grounded_notes: loan_status เป็นสถานะหลังปล่อยกู้ ไม่ใช่ผลอนุมัติหรือปฏิเสธ

roles.query_template: SELECT i.year, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CAST(AVG(l.funded_amnt) AS decimal(20,6)) AS avg_funded_amnt, CAST(AVG(l.int_rate) * 100 AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_int_rate_pct FROM loans_fact l JOIN issue_d_dim i ON l.issue_d_id = i.issue_d_id GROUP BY i.year ORDER BY i.year

grounded_notes: avg_int_rate_pct แปลงจาก int_rate × 100; เป็นการเปรียบเทียบเชิงพรรณนา

roles.query_template: SELECT h.home_ownership, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CAST(AVG(l.funded_amnt) AS decimal(20,6)) AS avg_funded_amnt, CAST(AVG(l.int_rate) * 100 AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_int_rate_pct, CAST(AVG(l.dti) AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_dti FROM loans_fact l JOIN home_ownership_dim h ON l.home_ownership_id = h.home_ownership_id GROUP BY h.home_ownership ORDER BY loan_count DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT e.emp_length, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, AVG(l.funded_amnt) AS avg_funded_amnt, AVG(l.int_rate) * 100 AS avg_int_rate_pct, AVG(l.dti) AS avg_dti FROM loans_fact l JOIN emp_length_dim e ON l.emp_length_id=e.emp_length_id GROUP BY e.emp_length), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_funded_amnt DESC, emp_length) AS highest, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_funded_amnt ASC, emp_length) AS lowest_overall FROM s), n AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_funded_amnt ASC, emp_length) AS lowest_non_na FROM s WHERE emp_length <> 'N/A'), extrema AS (SELECT 'highest' AS extreme_type, emp_length, loan_count, avg_funded_amnt, avg_int_rate_pct, avg_dti, 1 AS sort_order FROM r WHERE highest=1 UNION ALL SELECT 'lowest_overall', emp_length, loan_count, avg_funded_amnt, avg_int_rate_pct, avg_dti, 2 FROM r WHERE lowest_overall=1 UNION ALL SELECT 'lowest_non_na', emp_length, loan_count, avg_funded_amnt, avg_int_rate_pct, avg_dti, 3 FROM n WHERE lowest_non_na=1) SELECT extreme_type, emp_length, loan_count, CAST(avg_funded_amnt AS decimal(20,6)) AS avg_funded_amnt, CAST(avg_int_rate_pct AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_int_rate_pct, CAST(avg_dti AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_dti FROM extrema ORDER BY sort_order

WITH b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN dti IS NULL THEN 'NULL' WHEN dti < 10 THEN '<10' WHEN dti < 20 THEN '10-<20' WHEN dti < 30 THEN '20-<30' ELSE '30+' END AS dti_bucket, funded_amnt, int_rate FROM loans_fact) SELECT dti_bucket, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CAST(AVG(funded_amnt) AS decimal(20,6)) AS avg_funded_amnt, CAST(AVG(int_rate) * 100 AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_int_rate_pct FROM b GROUP BY dti_bucket ORDER BY CASE dti_bucket WHEN '<10' THEN 1 WHEN '10-<20' THEN 2 WHEN '20-<30' THEN 3 WHEN '30+' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

grounded_notes: ขอบเขต bucket เป็นไปตามคำถาม; ความแตกต่างเป็น association เชิงพรรณนา ไม่ใช่ causality

question_terms_any: ช่วงรายได้

roles.query_template: WITH b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN annual_inc < 50000 THEN '<50000' WHEN annual_inc < 70000 THEN '50000-<70000' WHEN annual_inc < 100000 THEN '70000-<100000' ELSE '100000+' END AS income_band, annual_inc, funded_amnt, int_rate, dti FROM loans_fact WHERE application_type = 'Individual' AND annual_inc IS NOT NULL) SELECT income_band, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CAST(MIN(annual_inc) AS decimal(20,2)) AS min_annual_inc, CAST(MAX(annual_inc) AS decimal(20,2)) AS max_annual_inc, CAST(AVG(funded_amnt) AS decimal(20,6)) AS avg_funded_amnt, CAST(AVG(int_rate) * 100 AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_int_rate_pct, CAST(AVG(dti) AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_dti FROM b GROUP BY income_band ORDER BY MIN(annual_inc)

SELECT i.year, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(l.loan_amnt) AS decimal(38,2))) AS requested_total, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(l.funded_amnt) AS decimal(38,2))) AS funded_total, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(l.loan_amnt-l.funded_amnt) AS decimal(38,2))) AS funding_gap, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(l.funded_amnt)/NULLIF(SUM(l.loan_amnt),0) AS decimal(12,8))) AS funding_ratio FROM loans_fact l JOIN issue_d_dim i ON l.issue_d_id=i.issue_d_id GROUP BY i.year ORDER BY i.year

grounded_notes: funding_ratio ไม่ใช่ approval rate เพราะไม่มี rejected-applications denominator หรือ approval-decision field

question_terms_all: สูงกว่าค่าเฉลี่ยทั้งพอร์ต
question_terms_any: ทุกกลุ่มที่ผ่าน

roles.query_template: WITH o AS (SELECT AVG(l.int_rate) AS overall_avg_int_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN s.loan_status='Charged Off' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS overall_charged_off_rate FROM loans_fact l JOIN loan_status_dim s ON l.loan_status_id=s.loan_status_id), g AS (SELECT e.emp_length, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, AVG(l.int_rate) AS avg_int_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN s.loan_status='Charged Off' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS charged_off_rate FROM loans_fact l JOIN emp_length_dim e ON l.emp_length_id=e.emp_length_id JOIN loan_status_dim s ON l.loan_status_id=s.loan_status_id GROUP BY e.emp_length) SELECT g.emp_length, g.loan_count, CAST(g.avg_int_rate*100 AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_int_rate_pct, CAST(g.charged_off_rate*100 AS decimal(12,6)) AS charged_off_rate_pct, CAST(o.overall_avg_int_rate*100 AS decimal(12,6)) AS overall_avg_int_rate_pct, CAST(o.overall_charged_off_rate*100 AS decimal(12,6)) AS overall_charged_off_rate_pct FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.avg_int_rate > o.overall_avg_int_rate AND g.charged_off_rate > o.overall_charged_off_rate ORDER BY g.charged_off_rate DESC

grounded_notes: เป็น descriptive segment screen ไม่ใช่ causal model หรือคำตัดสินสินเชื่อรายบุคคล
